# Installed by hipdnn-superbuild-ci.yml into the venv it passes as
# -DPython3_EXECUTABLE, before "Configure superbuild"; that step explains why the
# ordering matters for pytest.
#
# pytest -- the descriptor-packaging suite, and the frontend wheel tests.
# build  -- the PEP 517 frontend that packs the frontend wheel.
# numpy  -- imported by frontend_wheel_package/tests, not by the build.
# jsonschema -- the descriptor-packaging suite validates UHD sidecars against
#               uhd.schema.json; without it those checks skip.
# PyYAML, Jinja2 -- the DescriptorGenerator/IngestorGenerator tooling suites (HIPDNN_ENABLE_TOOLING_TESTS).
# clang-format -- IngestorGenerator tests/test_packs_formatting.py, which skips (and a strict
#   run fails the skip) without one. Pinned to the pre-commit hook's rev, because a formatter
#   fixed-point check is only meaningful against the formatter that defines the style.
#   tools/CMakeLists.txt hands the venv's copy to the suite as HIPDNN_CLANG_FORMAT.
#
# Installed with --upgrade, so nothing else is pinned here.
pytest
build
numpy
jsonschema
PyYAML
Jinja2
clang-format==18.1.4
